parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
接收消息的语言类型。取值：

- **zh**（默认）：中文
- **en**：英文

parameters.name: ShouldRecover
parameters.description:
是否恢复引流配置。取值：

- true：路由回滚

- false：路由撤销

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw modify-tr-firewall-v2-route-policy-scope --lang zh --tr-firewall-route-policy-id policy-4d724d0139df48f10000 --firewall-id vfw-tr-6520de0253bc46690000 --src-candidate-list CandidateType=VPC CandidateId=vpc-2ze9epancaw8t4sha0000 --dest-candidate-list CandidateType=VPC CandidateId=vpc-2ze9epancaw8t4uzi0000 --should-recover false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudfw ModifyTrFirewallV2RoutePolicyScope --region cn-hangzhou --SrcCandidateList '[{"CandidateType":"VPC","CandidateId":"vpc-2ze9epancaw8t4sha0000"}]' --ShouldRecover false --FirewallId 'vfw-tr-6520de0253bc46690000' --TrFirewallRoutePolicyId 'policy-4d724d0139df48f10000' --Lang zh --DestCandidateList '[{"CandidateType":"VPC","CandidateId":"vpc-2ze9epancaw8t4uzi0000"}]'
